name: Genie Spells
description:
When you reach a Paladin level specified in the Genie Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Chromatic Orb, Elementalism, Thunderous Smite

Level 5: Mirror Image, Phantasmal Force

Level 9: Fly, Gaseous Form

Level 13: Conjure Minor Elementals, Summon Elemental

Level 17: Banishing Smite, Contact Other Plane
